_note: Identity of files in the player's own model library. The models themselves are not in this repo (bought/fan art — see skyuss/assets/premium/README.md), but knowing which file is which ship is data worth keeping: tools/model-report.mjs prints the matching entry before it analyses anything, so an unnamed export is never a mystery twice.
